# Phase Three — Tiferes: Exact File Intent

## Read/Reconcile First
- `api/wallet/core/commerce/paidActionCatalog.js`
- `api/wallet/core/commerce/paidActionExecution*.js`
- `api/wallet/core/commerce/paidActionHandler*.js`
- `api/wallet/core/commerce/paidActionParameters.js`
- `api/wallet/routes/commerceActionExecute.js`
- `api/wallet/tests/paidAction*.test.js`
- `api/wallet/core/commerce/entitlement.js`
- `shared/commerce/model.js`
- `shared/commerce/render.js`
- `scripts/awtsmoos/ui/productCommerce.js`
- `scripts/awtsmoos/ui/foundation.js`

## Preferred New Small Modules
- universal capability definitions separated by product-family concern.
- a Radiance handler/fulfillment module if existing handler registry supports server-owned actions.
- a shared Radiance ownership/theme projector.
- focused tests for atomic grant, replay safety, catalog coverage, and UI model state.
- static catalog generator modules rather than inflating Apps/Games runtime renderers.

## Rewrite Law
Any existing file that must change will be rewritten completely after full readback. JS/MJS touched files start with exact required three-line B"H prologue, use tabs, contain extensive JSDoc, never minify statements, and stay under 120 lines by splitting responsibilities.
